opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the industry (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture).
opportunities.summary: A 30-day study tour that links successful young applicants directly to Nuffield Scholars, staying on farms to develop understanding of the industry, build networks and future opportunities. Fully funded, including all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. Applications open in November 2026.
